name: motion-kit
description: Character animation craft for games: a motion-craft skill (the twelve principles as games use them, walk and arm-swing numbers, stepped and puppet motion, the pose-sheet method, a judging rubric), an animator agent that plans motion as a pose sheet, a motion-judge agent that reviews recorded motion blind, and a motion-path probe (reel contact sheets, bone-path plots with arc, spacing and lag measures, a Godot bone-path recorder).
